Flagship case study / Lux Gear / UAE

Lux Gear.
Software behind the work.

A product catalogue grew into connected tools for document preparation, accounting imports, staff tasks and project files. My work covers the interfaces, processing rules and recovery paths that make those workflows usable.

My work

Full-stack development, document automation, workflow design and AI integration.

Core stack

Next.js · TypeScript · Python
PostgreSQL / Supabase · React Native

Delivery

Live web tools and checked accounting imports. Android APK built; further device and source checks remain.

01 / Document automation

An hour of entry.
A few minutes of review.

Staff were copying quotation details into accounting import sheets. I built a PDF and Excel conversion tool with an editable worksheet preview, saved batches and downloads matching the supplied Zoho Books templates.

Manual per quotation
60min
Reported with tool
3–4min
Less entry time
93–95%

Reported staff timings, not an independent time study. Across a 200-quotation workload, these imply 187–190 hours of capacity freed. The completed batch total and cash savings are not claimed.

Software reads the table first

PDF text positions and table geometry become structured rows. Quantities, prices, discounts and VAT are checked before export. An AI reader handles supported fallbacks; unknown values stay visible for staff review.

The preview is the output

The worksheet preview shares its cell model with the actual Excel export. Staff can append more originals, reopen saved work and correct entries without starting again. Error references help trace failed reads and downloads.

Actual quotation and draft-invoice imports were checked in Zoho Books against their original documents. That exposed tax mapping, project naming and customer matching issues that a successful Excel download alone would not reveal.

The converter is live. The latest invoice export refinements remain local, and unfamiliar source layouts and customer matches still need review. Invoice time savings have not been measured.

02 / Product information

One product record.
Consistent documents.

A lighting product’s dimensions, wattage, colour temperature, finish and protection rating need to agree wherever they appear. Shared templates turn the staff-edited record into the public product page, catalogue and technical datasheet.

Staff editProduct record

Specifications, options and images

→
  • Public product page
  • Catalogue listing
  • Technical datasheet / PDF

Architecture diagram, not a screenshot of private company data.

The work after the first build

I added manufacturer-sheet reading and picture selection, repaired custom RAL colour persistence, copied-product status, broken links and PDF save/download failures. Clear recovery states let staff retry a failed PDF without repeating a successful save or accidentally publishing a copied sheet.

03 / Team operations

Daily work.
A record that lasts.

Staff can add their own tasks, receive assignments, record blockers and time, and finish work. Managers set priorities, deadlines and approval requirements. Voice notes and transcription support task descriptions without long typed entries.

History and employee reviews

Task versions preserve what was open or finished on a selected date. Manager deletion retains earlier records. Date-based reports and PDF downloads give managers a clearer view of completed, overdue, urgent and carried-over work.

One account across the tools

Individual CMS accounts also open Team Hub. Server and database checks protect roles and private files. I repaired stale-browser admission and removed the numeric device cap without restoring revoked sessions.

A native Android client

Built with React Native using the same accounts and task workflow. A signed APK, secure session storage, durable offline updates, reconnect sync and a Firebase notification backend are implemented. The first release still needs complete acceptance on employees’ phones.

The web task workspace is deployed. Native locked-phone receipt is not yet verified. Report email was tested; recurring weekly delivery still requires activation checks.

04 / Manufacturer enquiries

Prepare from sources.
Keep decisions visible.

A BOQ, technical PDF and approved sample can disagree. I built a source-linked enquiry workspace that keeps printed specifications, quantities, proposed alternatives and staff decisions separate.

Staff work in an editable supplier-sheet layout with original product pictures, picture cropping, saved notes and Excel/PDF exports. Preparation and final approval have separate permissions. An actual staff-account flow was checked through saving, review, export and reopening.

A decision needs context

“Use the standard size”

That could mean an approved sample or an alternative proposed because of stock or cost. The software retains the source and the decision, so the next project does not silently inherit the same substitution.

AI assists with reading

Anthropic Haiku helps extract and organise source details. Structured-output checks, page and picture references, retained readings and human approval contain the uncertainty. Unread evidence and unresolved quantity mappings remain questions, not invented facts.

The first enquiry category is live. A ten-line real-source output was checked, but complete independent equivalence to the staff-prepared reference remains unverified. DWG-to-BOQ is planned, not a delivered feature.

05 / Quotation analysis

Historical quotes.
Traceable analysis.

I processed 225 supplied quotation PDFs, checked duplicates and revisions, and delivered an editable workbook containing 3,069 extracted item rows and 1,574 pictures linked to their source items.

Compare like with like

Lighting families, mounting styles and technical specifications are grouped for review. Price comparisons respect dates, units and revisions; metres, pieces, accessories and packages stay distinct.

Keep the original within reach

Source references and financial checks make the output auditable. Unresolved documents stay visible, and quoted quantities are not presented as actual orders, sales or inventory demand.

Alongside development and analysis, I supported lighting supplier comparisons and prepared an editable company profile. Commercial terms and original business documents remain private.

What runs now.
What comes next.

DWG-to-BOQ, automatic mailbox reading, AI-suggested assignments and approved follow-ups are future work. No unattended sending or independent commercial decisions are presented as live features.

The work behind the screens

Software that fits
the work people do.

The immediate result is less repeated data entry. The continuing value comes from reusable workflows, clearer records and tools that can grow as the team’s work changes.
